title: A billable invoice reaches AccountingHub as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Open Accounting > Sales > Invoices.
  4. Open work order 1's record.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 3:

  • The record is listed with no "Closed" pill and no "Internal" or "No Charge" badge.

Step 4:

  • The record has no "No Charge lines" block and none of its entries posts to a category account.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-R3: “Vendor bill lines, reclass entries and the shop supplies entry follow Story 7, S7-R3, S7-R3a, S7-R4 and S7-R4a, with the hub's accounts (the credit goes to the Shop supplies expense row, seeded 5100 Shop Supplies COGS: in the hub the amount lowers cost, where in QuickBooks it raises shop supplies income; gross and net profit come out the same in both, and the accountant can remap the row). A vendor bill or vendor credit line on internal or no-charge work posts to the category's expense account (Key Decision); when that category row is empty, the bill or credit posts as today, so the vendor can be paid, and only that line's move to the category account is Held with the reason "No Charge: [Category] row not mapped" (or "Internal: [Category] row not mapped") until the row is mapped. This is the one entry the hub raises itself instead of receiving it from core (confirmed by the hub owner on 2026-11-09), with this lifecycle: when the mapping is saved, the Held move is retried automatically, subject to the other posting checks, an open accounting period included; a bill or credit amended while the move is Held turns it Dismissed and the updated document is evaluated again, with a replacement move only when one is still needed; a bill or credit voided while Held turns it Dismissed with no replacement; a bill or credit amended or voided after the move posted reverses the original move and posts an updated one when needed, coordinated with the bill or credit correction so the same amount is never reversed twice; Held moves can be retried, Dismissed ones are never replayed (S4-R3); the move shows in reconciliation and on the Accounting Events page with its status and a link to the source bill or credit and its line. Invoices, vendor bills, credits and payments keep today's statuses.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026
